TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Settings.PlayerTimeo: How long to wait for a player to choose Rush / March / Hunker Down before defaulting to March.
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Dialog.Title: Tactical Initiative
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Dialog.Prompt: {name}, choose your approach for this round:
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Choice.Rush.Label: Rush
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Choice.Rush.Hint: +3 initiative, but -1 to attacks, saves, and checks this round.
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Choice.March.Label: March
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Choice.March.Hint: Normal initiative, no penalty or bonus.
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Choice.Hunker.Label: Hunker Down
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Choice.Hunker.Hint: -6 initiative, but +2 to attacks, saves, and checks this round.
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Chat.DefaultedToMarc: {name} did not choose in time and defaults to March.
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Settings.AnnounceBos: Post a public chat message when a Boss-tagged creature reaches 0 HP.
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Settings.KillAttribu: How recent a damaging hit must be to credit the killer in a boss-death message.
TACTICAL_INITIATIVE.Chat.RestoreNoCombat: That combat no longer exists; the token was un-hidden but not re-added.
